proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Seeking Alternative Shareholder Right to Call a Special Meeting
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents so owners of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting, reducing the current 25% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Seeking Amendment to Existing Clawback Provisions
proposals.proponent: United Steel, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union (USW)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Committee to expand the clawback policy to allow recoupment of incentive pay for executive conduct violating law or policy, or failures to manage risks, causing harm.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Seeking Report on Just Transition
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to report on how Marathon is addressing the social impacts of its climate strategy on workers and communities, consistent with ILO Just Transition guidelines.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.
